title: INSTALLATION OF GEAR HOUSING
ocr_text:
SR-40

STEERING — Power Steering

INSTALLATION OF GEAR HOUSING
(See page SR-26)

1. INSTALL GEAR HOUSING ASSEMBLY
NOTE: Be careful not to damage the boots. Install four bolts and torque them.
Torque: 770 kg-cm (56 ft-lb, 76 N-m)

2. CONNECT RETURN AND PRESSURE LINE
(a) Install the union seat.
(b) Using SST, connect the pressure line and torque it.
SST 09631-22020
Torque: 390 kg-cm (28 ft-lb, 38 N-m)

3. CONNECT TIE ROD ENDS
(a) Install the tie rod end set nut and torque it.
Torque: 600 kg-cm (43 ft-lb, 59 N-m)
(b) Install the new cotter pin.

4. INSTALL INTERMEDIATE SHAFT
(a) Install the column side first.
(b) Install the rack housing side.
(c) Install the two bolts and torque them.
Torque: 350 kg-cm (25 ft-lb, 34 N-m)

5. FILL WITH POWER STEERING FLUID
(See page SR-14)

6. BLEED SYSTEM (See page SR-15)

7. CHECK FOR FLUID LEAKS

8. ADJUST TOE-IN (See page FA-5)
